messages:
Ava (People Ops): Lena starts Mon 2025-04-07. Tagging @Diego and @Sam — we need I-9 verification + background check intake completed by EOD Fri.
Diego (HRBP): Got it. I'll kick off the background check today. Which package? standard + SSN trace?
onboarding-bot: Background check link sent to lena.maldonado@gmail.com — tracker ID BG-7832. Status: pending.
Sam (IT): I'll order laptop + MDM enroll. Need department + manager. Ava, can you confirm?
Ava (People Ops): Manager is Marco (Eng). Dept: Infrastructure. Laptop config: MacBook Pro -> dev image. Also need Lena's preferred company email (first.last).
Lena (New Hire): Hi all! My personal email is lena.maldonado@gmail.com — for the background link please. For I-9 I can bring passport and driver's license. Is passport alone ok?
Diego (HRBP): Passport alone is acceptable as List A. Bring the original. If remote, upload a clear photo to the HR portal and we'll verify via video call. See: https://www.uscis.gov/i-9-central/list-of-acceptable-documents
Ava (People Ops): Quick I-9 checklist:
```
- Bring original photo ID(s): Passport OR (DL + SSN card OR birth certificate)
- If remote: upload scans before day 1 and have an on-camera verification scheduled
- HR schedules a 30min I-9 Zoom slot on day 1 (we'll calendar invite)
```
Ava (People Ops): Orientation outline for day 1:
- 10:00am Intro with Marco (team + role expectations)
- 11:00am IT setup (accounts + device provisioning)
- 2:00pm Benefits overview (health, 401k, time off)
Zoom links in calendar invite — onboarding@redwood-inference.com sent invites.
Sam (IT): FYI I'll submit Okta + Google Workspace request and place the laptop order today. ETA 3 business days for device imaging. Tagging infra-equipment for accessory allocation.
Ava (People Ops): One more: security background requires completion of the eForm from HireSecure. Lena, please watch for an email from hiresecure@vendor.com. If you don't see it within the hour check spam.
Lena (New Hire): Thanks — I just received the HireSecure email and the BG link. Starting it now.
Diego (HRBP): I'll monitor BG-7832. If anything flags we'll pause provisioning and notify you promptly.
Ava (People Ops): If everyone can confirm the tasks they own by EOD Thursday that would be great so we don't delay Monday start. Please reply with :thumbsup: when done.
